SARBA GUI source kit status
===========================
App name: SARBA GUI
Icon: SG red theme
Target: Windows 10/11 x64
Frame generation: Removed by design

Checks run in this workspace:
- Python compileall: PASS
- Unit tests: 7 PASS
- FPS parser uses captured CSV frame intervals; it does not invent an FPS value.
- Temp cleanup unit test verifies that deletion is confined to the configured user TEMP root.

Not verified here:
- Windows GUI runtime (PySide6 could not be installed in this network-restricted Linux workspace)
- Windows .exe / setup compilation
- PresentMon capture against MSI App Player / Free Fire on the target PC
- GTX 1660 Super fan-control behavior on the user's installed driver and board

Build:
- Run BUILD_SARBA_GUI.bat on a Windows x64 PC with Python 3.10+ and Internet access.
- For a standard setup/uninstall EXE, install Inno Setup 6 before building.
- Alternatively, commit the project files to a repository you can write to and run .github/workflows/build-windows.yml.
